VizSpecSchema.description: Root for the full published schema (`vizspec.schema.json`). The complete discriminated union of every openchart spec kind.

VizSpec.description:
Top-level visualization spec: union discriminated by structural shape.

- ChartSpec: has `mark` field (no `type`, no `layer`)
- LayerSpec: has `layer` field
- TableSpec: has `type: 'table'`
- GraphSpec: has `type: 'graph'`
- SankeySpec: has `type: 'sankey'`
- TileMapSpec: has `type: 'tilemap'`
- BarListSpec: has `type: 'barlist'`

Election parliament (hemicycle) charts are `ChartSpec` with `mark: 'parliament'`, not a separate top-level type: seat data (party + seats) maps naturally onto encoding.color/y like arc and waffle, and riding the existing chart pipeline gets scales, legend, tooltips, a11y, and dark mode for free instead of a second bespoke compile path (see `packages/engine/src/charts/parliament/`).

point.description:
Show point markers on line/area marks.
- true: filled circles at each data point
- 'transparent': invisible hover targets (legacy behavior)
- 'endpoints': show only first and last point per series (hollow dots)
- 'last' / 'first': show only the last (or first) point — filled dot,   no white halo. Useful for highlighting the latest reading on a line   chart and the default for sparkline mode.
- false: no point marks (default; uses voronoi overlay for tooltips)

interpolate.description: Curve interpolation for line/area marks. Maps to d3-shape curve factories.

orient.description: Explicit orientation override for bar marks.

innerRadius.description: Inner radius for arc marks. >0 produces a donut, 0 or omitted produces a pie.

startAngle.description: Start angle in radians for arc marks. Defaults to 0 (full pie/donut). Combined with `endAngle`, restricts the pie/donut to a partial sweep, e.g. `startAngle: -Math.PI / 2, endAngle: Math.PI / 2` for a half-donut (election-style results donut). Angles follow d3's convention: 0 is straight up, increasing clockwise. Only meaningful when `type` is `'arc'`.

endAngle.description: End angle in radians for arc marks. Defaults to 2*Math.PI (full pie/donut). See `startAngle`. Only meaningful when `type` is `'arc'`.

cornerRadius.description: Corner radius for rect/bar marks. 'pill' sets rx to half the bar thickness.

size.description: Fixed bar thickness in pixels for bar/column marks. When set, bars are this height (horizontal) or width (vertical), centered within the band.

filled.description: Whether the mark is filled (vs stroked only).

clip.description: Clip marks to the chart area.

trendline.description: Overlay a least-squares regression line on scatter (point) marks. Defaults to true. Set `mark: { type: 'point', trendline: false }` to suppress it when the chart already carries its own reference line (e.g. a manual x=y diagonal in a separate layer), which would otherwise produce two competing diagonals.

dx.description: Horizontal pixel offset from the data anchor. Only meaningful when `type` is `'text'`. Use it to lift a label clear of the mark it annotates instead of shifting the underlying data value.

dy.description: Vertical pixel offset from the data anchor (negative = up). Only meaningful when `type` is `'text'`. `{ type: 'text', dy: -10 }` floats each label ten pixels above its point.

align.description: Horizontal alignment of text marks relative to their anchor. Defaults to `'center'`.

baseline.description: Vertical alignment of text marks relative to their anchor. Defaults to `'middle'`.

fontSize.description: Font size in pixels for text marks. Ignored when the `size` encoding channel is present (which scales font size from a data field). `size` is already taken by bar thickness, hence the distinct name.

fillPattern.description:
Pattern-fill reinforcement for filled marks (bar, area, arc).

- `'auto'`: assign a per-series SVG pattern (diagonal hatch, dots,   crosshatch, vertical lines) layered over each series color so series   remain distinguishable without color vision. Marks too small to show   a legible pattern keep their solid fill.
- `'none'` (default): solid fills only.

style.description:
Visual style for range marks. Only meaningful when `type` is `'range'`.
- 'dumbbell' (default): a dot at each end joined by a connector line.   The start dot is muted, the end dot carries the accent color.
- 'arrow': a line with an arrowhead at the x2/y2 end, the strongest   "change between two points in time" form.
- 'bar': a plain floating range bar spanning start to end.

colorByDirection.description: Color range marks by direction of change. Only meaningful when `type` is `'range'`. When true, increases (x2 > x, or y2 > y) use the theme's `positive` semantic color and decreases use `negative`. A field-based `encoding.color` takes precedence over direction coloring.

units.description: Total number of cells in a waffle grid. Only meaningful when `type` is `'waffle'`. Category values normalize to this many cells via largest-remainder rounding so the grid always sums exactly. Default 100.

columns.description: Number of columns in a waffle grid. Only meaningful when `type` is `'waffle'`. Rows derive from `units / columns`. Default 10.

weekStart.description: First day of the week for calendar marks. Only meaningful when `type` is `'calendar'`. Controls which weekday occupies the top row of each band. Defaults to 'monday' (ISO week convention).

cellRadius.description: Corner radius in pixels for calendar day cells. Only meaningful when `type` is `'calendar'`. Defaults to 1.

shape.description: Seat layout shape for parliament marks. Only meaningful when `type` is `'parliament'`. `'hemicycle'` (default, and currently the only shape) packs seats into concentric semicircular arcs, party-grouped left to right.

seatRadius.description: Seat dot radius in pixels for parliament marks. `'auto'` (default) sizes dots to fill the available hemicycle rings for the given seat count. Only meaningful when `type` is `'parliament'`.

majorityLine.description: The majority-threshold line and "N to win" label on parliament marks. Only meaningful when `type` is `'parliament'`. `true` (default) draws the line at a simple majority (half the seats plus one); `false` hides it. The object form overrides the threshold and label: `{ seats }` sets a custom seat count (e.g. a two-thirds supermajority) and `{ label }` overrides the default "N to win" text. A `seats` value outside `1..totalSeats` warns and falls back to the simple-majority default.

ChartSpec.description:
Chart specification: the primary input for standard chart types.

Uses the Vega-Lite `mark` property instead of `type` to specify the visualization mark. The mark can be a string shorthand or an object with additional properties (interpolation, point markers, etc.).

This is a discriminated union — the `mark` value determines which encoding channels are required. TypeScript enforces required channels at compile time, matching the runtime rules in `MARK_ENCODING_RULES`.

MarkType.description:
Supported mark types, following Vega-Lite conventions.

Mapping from previous OpenChart chart types:
- 'bar' covers both horizontal bars (old 'bar') and vertical columns (old 'column')
- 'arc' covers both pie (old 'pie') and donut (old 'donut')
- 'point' replaces old 'scatter'
- 'circle' replaces old 'dot'
- 'line' and 'area' unchanged

New mark types not in previous OpenChart:
- 'text': data-positioned text labels
- 'rule': reference lines as data marks
- 'tick': strip/rug plot marks
- 'rect': heatmaps and 2D binned plots
- 'range': dumbbell / arrow / range-bar plots spanning two values per category
- 'waffle': unit grids ("x of 100") for part-to-whole counts
- 'calendar': GitHub-style calendar heatmap (weeks x weekdays, daily dates)
- 'parliament': hemicycle seat-dot chart for election/legislature results

GradientDef.description: A gradient definition, either linear or radial.

stops.description: Color stops from start to end.

LinearGradient.description: Linear gradient definition. Coordinates are in [0,1] normalized space relative to the mark's bounding box (maps to SVG gradientUnits="objectBoundingBox").

color.description: CSS color string at this stop.

opacity.description: Opacity at this stop, 0 to 1. Maps to SVG stop-opacity.

GradientStop.description: A single color stop in a gradient definition.

stops.description: Color stops from inner to outer.

RadialGradient.description: Radial gradient definition. Coordinates are in [0,1] normalized space relative to the mark's bounding box.

x.description: Horizontal position channel. Required for: bar, line, area, point, tick, rect, lollipop. Maps a field to the x-axis. Use `type: 'temporal'` for dates, `'nominal'` for categories, `'quantitative'` for numbers.

y.description: Vertical position channel. Required for: bar, line, area, point, tick, rect, arc, lollipop. For arc marks, this is the value field (slice size). For all others it's the y-axis position.

color.description: Color channel. Required for arc marks (determines pie/donut slice coloring). Optional for all other marks -- used for series differentiation on multi-series charts, or heatmap intensity. Accepts a conditional definition to apply colors based on data predicates, or a bare `{ value }` constant (VL aligned; expanded to the mark-level fill/stroke).

size.description: Size channel. Used by point/bubble charts to scale dot area by a quantitative field. Accepts a conditional definition to vary size based on data predicates, or a bare `{ value }` constant (VL aligned; expanded to `mark.size`).

detail.description: Detail channel. Groups data into multiple series without mapping to a visual property. Useful when you want separate lines per category but don't need the color to differ.

key.description: Identity channel for data-update transitions. Maps a field whose value uniquely identifies each datum across updates. Mirrors Vega-Lite's key channel. Not visually encoded. Optional: charts derive sensible default keys.

x2.description: Secondary x position. Used with `x` to define a horizontal span (rect marks, error bars). Both `x` and `x2` must be quantitative.

y2.description: Secondary y position. Used with `y` to define a vertical span (rect marks, error bands). Both `y` and `y2` must be quantitative.

opacity.description: Data-driven opacity (0-1 range). Accepts a conditional definition to vary opacity based on data predicates (e.g., highlight selected points), or a bare `{ value }` constant (VL aligned; expanded to `mark.opacity`).

strokeDash.description: Stroke dash pattern encoding. Maps a nominal/ordinal field to different dash patterns on line and rule marks. Useful when color alone doesn't distinguish series well.

angle.description: Rotation angle encoding for point marks. Maps a quantitative field to 0-360 degrees.

text.description: Text content for `text` marks. Required when mark is `'text'`. Not meaningful for other mark types.

tooltip.description: Tooltip field(s). Shown on hover. Can be a single channel or an array for multi-field tooltips. Independent of the x/y/color encoding.

theta.description: Canonical value channel for arc marks (quantitative — the slice value).

facet.description: Facet channel: partitions data into a grid of small-multiple panels. Each unique value of the facet field produces one panel. Panels share scales by default; use `resolve: { scale: { y: 'independent' } }` for per-panel axes.

ArcEncoding<DataRow>.description:
Encoding for arc marks (pie/donut charts).
- `theta`: required (quantitative — the canonical slice value channel)
- `color`: required (nominal/ordinal — the category)
- `y`: deprecated alias for `theta`, accepted for backward compatibility

field.description:
Data field name (column in the data array).

When using `ChartSpec<TData>` with a typed data array, this is constrained to the actual column names of `TData`. Typos fail at compile time and IDEs autocomplete your column names.

type.description:
How to interpret the field values.
- quantitative: continuous numbers (scale: linear)
- temporal: dates/times (scale: time)
- nominal: unordered categories (scale: ordinal)
- ordinal: ordered categories (scale: ordinal)

aggregate.description: Optional aggregate to apply before encoding.

axis.description: Axis configuration. Set to `false` to suppress axis entirely (no space reserved). `null` is accepted as a VL-aligned alias for `false`.

stack.description:
Stacking behavior for quantitative channels (Vega-Lite aligned).

Vega-Lite accepts `'zero' | 'normalize' | 'center' | null`. OpenChart adds `true` (sugar for `'zero'`) and `false` (sugar for `null`) so callers can write `stack: true` / `stack: false` without learning the string forms. The string forms are still the canonical input — the boolean shorthand is normalized to the matching string before reaching layout.

- undefined: chart-type default (see below) -- stacked for bar/column/area
- true | 'zero': stack from zero baseline
- 'normalize': stack and normalize to fraction of total (0-1 per category)
- 'center': center stacks around zero (streamgraph style)
- null | false: no stacking -- renders grouped/dodged (bar) or overlap (area)

**Defaults differ by chart type:**
- **Bar/Column**: defaults to stacked (`'zero'`), Vega-Lite aligned. Use   `stack: null` (or `false`) for grouped/side-by-side bars.
- **Area**: defaults to stacked (`'zero'`), Vega-Lite aligned. Use   `stack: null` (or `false`) to opt into overlap rendering, where each   series renders as a translucent gradient band anchored at the   y-domain baseline.
- **Line**: stacking is not applied (lines always overlap).

bin.description:
Encoding-level bin shorthand (Vega-Lite aligned). When set, auto-generates a BinTransform during normalization and updates the field reference to the binned output (convention: `bin_<fieldName>`).
- true: bin with default params
- BinParams: bin with custom params (maxbins, step, etc.)

timeUnit.description: Encoding-level timeUnit shorthand (Vega-Lite aligned). When set, auto-generates a TimeUnitTransform during normalization and updates the field reference to the output (convention: `<timeUnit>_<fieldName>`).

sort.description:
Sort order for categorical (nominal/ordinal) scale domains (Vega-Lite aligned).
- 'ascending': sort domain values ascending (default VL behavior)
- 'descending': sort domain values descending
- null: use data order (no sorting)
- undefined: ascending (VL default)
- 'x' | '-x' | 'y' | '-y': sort by another channel's values ('-' prefix   for descending). The VL ranked-bar idiom: `sort: '-y'` orders categories   by value, largest first. Resolved into an explicit domain during the   pre-validation sugar expansion.
- string[]: explicit value order. Listed values come first (in the given   order); unlisted data values follow in data order.
- SortByField: sort by the aggregated values of another field.

legend.description: Legend configuration for this channel (Vega-Lite aligned). Only meaningful on the `color` channel. `null` hides the legend (the VL idiom for `legend.show = false`); a config object merges into the top-level `legend` (top-level keys win on conflict).

title.description: Display title override (Vega-Lite aligned). Used as the label in tooltips instead of the raw field name. Also usable for axis titles, but `axis.title` takes precedence there.

format.description: Format string for values (Vega-Lite aligned). For quantitative fields: d3-format string (e.g. ",.0f", "$,.2f"). For temporal fields: d3-time-format string (e.g. "%Y", "%b %d"). Used in tooltips; `axis.format` takes precedence for axis tick labels.

highlight.description:
Emphasis highlight for the color channel. Names one or more series values to visually emphasize; all other series are muted to a neutral gray.

Only meaningful on the `color` encoding channel. On other channels this property is ignored.

EncodingChannel<DataRow>.description:
A single encoding channel mapping a data field to a visual property.

Follows the Vega-Lite encoding model: field identifies the column, type determines how the engine interprets values, aggregate applies a transformation before encoding.

FieldType.description: Data field type, following Vega-Lite conventions.

AggregateOp.description: Aggregate function applied to a field before encoding.

title.description: Axis title text. If omitted, the field name is used.

format.description: Number format string (d3-format). e.g. ",.0f" for comma-separated integers.

tickCount.description: Override tick count. Engine picks a sensible default if omitted.

grid.description: Whether to show gridlines for this axis.

labelAngle.description: Rotation angle in degrees for tick labels. Common values: -45, -90, 90.

orient.description: Axis orientation override.

labelFlush.description: Whether to flush labels to the axis edges.

domain.description: Whether to show the axis domain line.

titlePadding.description: Padding between axis title and axis.

labelPadding.description: Padding between tick labels and axis.

labelColor.description: Color override for axis tick labels and title. Useful in dual-axis charts to match axis color to its series.

labelSuffix.description: Literal string appended to every formatted tick label. e.g. "B" gives "$4.5B" when format is "$,.1~f".

labelField.description: Secondary data field to display alongside each tick label. Renders in lighter weight/color. Only effective on categorical y-axis labels (horizontal bar charts).

tickPosition.description: Where tick labels render relative to the chart area. Editorial line/area y-axes default to `'inline'`: labels sit above their gridlines at the chart's left edge, with no left gutter, axis line, or tick marks. Other axis types default to `'gutter'` (the classic placement outside the chart area).

AxisConfig.description: Axis configuration for an encoding channel.

domain.description: Explicit domain override. Auto-derived from data if omitted. Continuous scales take `[min, max]`; threshold scales take the full list of class break values; categorical scales take the value list.

type.description: Scale type override. Usually inferred from field type.

nice.description: Whether to nice-ify the domain for clean tick values. Defaults to true.

zero.description: Whether the domain should include zero. Defaults to true for quantitative.

clip.description: When true and domain is set, filter out data rows with values outside the domain range.

scheme.description: Named color scheme (Vega-Lite aligned). Resolved against the core palette registry (sequential: blue, green, orange, purple, teal; diverging: redBlue, brownTeal; categorical) during the pre-validation sugar expansion; common VL names (blues, greens, category10, ...) are accepted as aliases. Unknown names fail validation with the supported list. An explicit `range` wins over `scheme`.

ScaleConfig.description: Scale configuration for an encoding channel.

TimeUnit.description: Time unit granularity for temporal field transformations. Follows Vega-Lite conventions.

field.description: Data field whose values determine the category order.

op.description: Aggregate applied per category before comparing. Defaults to 'sum'.

SortByField.description: Sort a categorical domain by the aggregated values of another field (Vega-Lite EncodingSortField).

position.description: Override the legend position. If omitted, the responsive strategy decides.

offset.description: Pixel offset for fine-tuning legend position.

show.description: Whether to show the legend. Defaults to true. Set to false to hide.

columns.description: Number of columns for horizontal legend layout. Overrides the default row limit.

symbolLimit.description: Max number of legend entries before truncation. Remaining entries show as "+N more".

maxRows.description: Maximum number of rows for top-positioned legends before truncation. Defaults to 2.

exclude.description: Series names to exclude from the legend. Excluded series still render in the chart.

LegendConfig.description: Legend display configuration. Overrides the responsive-default position.

LegendPosition.description: Legend position at a given breakpoint.

dx.description: Horizontal pixel offset.

dy.description: Vertical pixel offset.

AnnotationOffset.description: Pixel offset for fine-grained annotation positioning.

condition.description: One or more conditions to evaluate.

value.description: Default value when no condition matches. Accepted values: CSS color string, opacity (0-1), size number, boolean flag, or a gradient definition for color channels.

ConditionalValueDef<DataRow>.description: A conditional value definition for an encoding channel. Evaluates conditions in order, falling back to the default value.

test.description: Predicate to test against each datum.

value.description: Static value to use when the condition is true. Accepted values: CSS color string, opacity (0-1), size number, boolean flag, or a gradient definition for color channels.

field.description: Data field to use when the condition is true. Constrained to column names of `TData` when using `ChartSpec<TData>`.

type.description: Field type for the conditional field.

Condition<DataRow>.description: A single condition with a test predicate and resulting value/field. When the test passes for a datum, the condition's value/field is used.

FilterPredicate.description: A filter predicate: a field predicate or logical combination of predicates.

field.description: Data field to test. Note: FieldPredicate is used in transforms (FilterTransform) which operate on the raw DataRow type — field is typed as string here since transforms can reference computed/derived fields not present in the original TData.

valid.description: Whether the value is valid (non-null, non-undefined, non-NaN).

FieldPredicate.description: A predicate that tests a field value against a condition.

RelativeTimeRef.description: A relative-time reference that resolves against the data extent.

LogicalAnd<FilterPredicate>.description: Logical AND combinator for filter predicates.

LogicalOr<FilterPredicate>.description: Logical OR combinator for filter predicates.

LogicalNot<FilterPredicate>.description: Logical NOT combinator for filter predicates.

value.description: The constant value: CSS color string, size number, opacity (0-1), or gradient.

ValueDef.description: A constant value definition for an encoding channel (Vega-Lite aligned). The VL idiom for a fixed visual property, e.g. `color: { value: '#1b7fa3' }`. Expanded to the matching mark-level property (fill/stroke, size, opacity) during the pre-validation sugar expansion.

field.description: Data field to partition by. Each unique value produces one panel.

columns.description: Number of columns in the wrap grid. Auto-computed when omitted.

sort.description: Sort order for panel values. Default ascending.

FacetChannel<DataRow>.description:
Facet channel definition: partitions data into small-multiple panels.

Unlike positional channels, facet only needs a field, a categorical type, and optional layout hints (columns, sort). It does not carry scale/axis config because it produces a grid, not a visual encoding.

DataRow.description: Data row: a plain object with string keys.

Transform.description: Discriminated union of all transform types.

FilterTransform.description: Filter transform: removes rows that don't match the predicate.

BinTransform.description: Bin transform: adds binned field(s) to each row.

CalculateTransform.description: Calculate transform: adds a computed field to each row.

value.description: Constant value for binary operations when field2 is not provided.

TimeUnitTransform.description: Time unit transform: extracts a time unit from a temporal field.

AggregateTransform.description: Aggregate transform: group rows and compute summary statistics (VL aligned). Produces one row per group with the groupby fields and computed aggregates.

as.description: Output field names for [key, value]. Defaults to ['key', 'value'].

FoldTransform.description: Fold transform: unpivot wide-format columns into key/value rows (VL aligned). For each input row, produces N output rows (one per fold field) with all non-fold fields copied plus a key column (field name) and value column (field value).

sort.description: Fields to sort by within each partition.

groupby.description: Fields to partition (group) by. Each group is windowed independently.

WindowTransform.description: Window transform: computes values relative to other rows in sort order within a partition.

offset.description: Row offset for lag/lead/diff/pct_change. Defaults to 1.

WindowFieldDef.description: Window field definition specifying which operation to compute.

WindowOp.description: Window operation types for computing values relative to other rows.

WindowSortField.description: Sort field definition for window transforms.

eyebrow.description: Editorial kicker/category label rendered above the title. Typically uppercase, tracked, and tinted with the accent color (e.g. "Equities · Single Ticker"). Term follows IBM Carbon and Atlassian Design System conventions; not part of Vega-Lite's title model.

title.description: Main title displayed above the visualization.

subtitle.description: Subtitle displayed below the title, typically providing context.

source.description: Data source attribution, displayed below the chart area.

footer.description: Footer text, displayed at the very bottom.

brand.description: Right-anchored brand block on the footer row, paired with a small accent dot to its left. Visually balances the source/byline left-anchored text. When set, suppresses the default `tryOpenData.ai` watermark for this chart.

Chrome.description: Editorial chrome elements: eyebrow, title, subtitle, source attribution, byline, footer. These are first-class structural elements, not string-only afterthoughts. Each element can be a simple string or a ChromeText object with style overrides.

style.description: Optional style overrides. Theme defaults are used for any omitted property.

ChromeText.description: A chrome text element with optional style overrides.

fontSize.description: Font size in pixels.

color.description: Text color (CSS color string).

ChromeTextStyle.description: Style overrides for a chrome text element.

description.description: Alt text announced by screen readers for the chart as a whole. Replaces the auto-generated description. Also settable via the top-level `description` field (Vega-Lite convention); this field wins when both are present.

hidden.description: Hide the chart from assistive technology entirely (`aria-hidden`). Use only when the chart is decorative or the surrounding content already conveys the same information. Also suppresses the hidden screen-reader data table and keyboard mark navigation.

A11yConfig.description:
Author-facing accessibility overrides.

Everything here is optional; when omitted, openchart auto-generates alt text, ARIA labels, and a screen-reader data table from the spec and data.

delta.description: Optional change indicator, e.g. "+1.4%". Rendered next to the value.

deltaTone.description: Tone for the delta. 'up' = positive (green), 'down' = negative (red). Default 'up'.

secondary.description: Optional secondary value (e.g. multiplier "10.3×"). Rendered after the delta.

Metric.description:
A KPI/metric cell rendered above the chart in a horizontal row.

Used for editorial dashboards (e.g. "CLOSE $186.10 +1.4%") where the chart is paired with summary statistics. Cells lay out evenly across the chart width. Hidden in sparkline mode; auto-stripped when the container can't fit the laid-out values.

Annotation.description: Discriminated union of all annotation types.

id.description: Stable identifier for selection and edit callbacks. When provided, edit events include this ID for reliable element matching.

fill.description: Fill color for the annotation element.

stroke.description: Stroke color for the annotation element.

zIndex.description: Z-index for render ordering. Higher values render on top.

responsive.description: When false, the annotation is always shown even at compact breakpoints. Default true.

text.description:
The annotation text. Required for text annotations.

Supports inline `**bold**` spans, so emphasis lands on the key phrase rather than the whole block: `'Inflation peaked at **8.5%**'`. Unmatched `**` (and empty `****`) render literally. `\n` starts a new line.

priority.description: Thinning priority (lower = kept longer at narrow widths). When omitted, spec order is used.

subtitle.description:
Optional muted second-tone text rendered below the primary `text`. Used for supporting context (e.g. methodology, source). Newlines in `text` still produce multi-line primary; subtitle is a separate block.

Supports the same inline `**bold**` spans as `text`. When a subtitle is present and no `fontWeight` is set, the primary `text` resolves to weight 700 — the lede + context stack.

dot.description:
Open-ring marker drawn on the data point itself (not on the pulled-back connector tip).

Left unset, a default marker appears whenever a connector is enabled and carries no arrowhead — the leader points, the ring lands. An arrowed connector gets no marker unless you ask for one: the head already marks the spot. `dot: false` is always bare; an explicit `dot` always wins.

`true` uses the default style; pass an object to override radius, fill, stroke, or strokeWidth.

fontSize.description: Font size override.

offset.description: Pixel offset from the computed position.

anchor.description: Anchor direction for label placement relative to the data point.

connector.description:
Connector from label to anchor point.
- `true` (default): straight line, no arrow
- `'straight'`: straight line, no arrow
- `'curve'`: curved arrow with arrowhead
- `'drop-line'`: vertical line through the data point's x
- `{ type, arrow? }`: object form for explicit arrow control
- `false`: no connector

The connector leaves the text block on the side facing the data point, with a small standoff gap. A leader shorter than 14px is dropped as noise (the marker alone reads better), as is a connector whose target sits inside the text block. Widen `offset` if you want the line back.

from.description: Offset for the label-end of the connector.

to.description: Offset for the data-point-end of the connector.

connectorOffset.description: Per-endpoint offsets for the connector line. Allows fine-tuning where the connector starts and ends.

background.description:
Background plate behind the text, for readability over chart lines.

`true` uses the theme surface, so the plate follows light/dark mode. A color string sets it explicitly. Prefer `true`: a hardcoded '#ffffff' stays white in dark mode and the text turns light-gray-on-white.

halo.description: Whether to show the paint-order stroke halo behind text. Default true. Set false for white text on colored backgrounds.

TextAnnotation.description: Text annotation positioned at a data coordinate. Shows a callout label at a specific point in the chart.

fill.description: Fill color. Defaults to theme background for an "open ring" look.

stroke.description: Stroke color. Defaults to the connector's resolved stroke, so marker and leader read as one system.

AnnotationDot.description: Style overrides for the dot marker drawn at the data point.

AnnotationAnchor.description: Anchor direction for annotation label placement relative to the data point.

arrow.description: Whether to draw an arrowhead at the data-point end. Default: true for curve, false for straight. Drop-line never takes a head.

ConnectorConfig.description: Object form of the connector config, allowing arrow control.

id.description: Stable identifier for selection and edit callbacks. When provided, edit events include this ID for reliable element matching.

fill.description: Fill color for the annotation element.

stroke.description: Stroke color for the annotation element.

zIndex.description: Z-index for render ordering. Higher values render on top.

responsive.description: When false, the annotation is always shown even at compact breakpoints. Default true.

x1.description: Start of the range on the x-axis.

x2.description: End of the range on the x-axis.

y1.description: Start of the range on the y-axis.

y2.description: End of the range on the y-axis.

extendToEdges.description: For band/point (ordinal) x or y scales, whether the range extends from the data point's center out to the band/step edge. Default `true`: a range on a bar chart spans full columns, and a range on a line chart extends half a step past the first/last point so the band reaches the plot edge. Set `false` to anchor the range exactly at the data point centers instead — useful when you want the band inset from the axis (e.g. starting at the first data point rather than flush against the y-axis guide). No effect on linear/time scales.

labelOffset.description: Pixel offset for the range label.

labelAnchor.description: Anchor direction for the range label.

fontSize.description: Font size override for the range label (px). Default: 11.

fontWeight.description: Font weight override for the range label. Default: 500.

RangeAnnotation.description: Range annotation highlighting a region of the chart. Defined by x1/x2 (vertical band) or y1/y2 (horizontal band) or both (rectangle).

id.description: Stable identifier for selection and edit callbacks. When provided, edit events include this ID for reliable element matching.

fill.description: Fill color for the annotation element.

stroke.description: Stroke color for the annotation element.

zIndex.description: Z-index for render ordering. Higher values render on top.

responsive.description: When false, the annotation is always shown even at compact breakpoints. Default true.

type.description: Discriminant. `'refline'` is canonical and the only value in the type. `'rule'` (it collides with the `rule` mark type) is still accepted at runtime for backward compatibility -- the spec-sugar pass rewrites it to `'refline'` with a deprecation warning before validation -- but it is not part of this type. Use `'refline'`.

x.description: X-axis value for a vertical reference line.

y.description: Y-axis value for a horizontal reference line.

style.description: Line style.

strokeDash.description: Raw SVG dash pattern override, e.g. [4, 4]. Takes precedence over style.

labelOffset.description: Pixel offset for the reference line label.

labelAnchor.description: Anchor direction for the reference line label.

fontSize.description: Label font size in pixels. Default: 11.

RefLineAnnotation.description: Reference line annotation: a horizontal or vertical line at a data value. Useful for baselines (zero), targets, or thresholds.

LabelSpec.description: Shorthand: `false` disables all labels, `true` uses defaults, or pass a full config object.

density.description: How many labels to show. Defaults to 'auto'.

format.description: Number format override for label values (d3-format string, e.g. ",.0f").

prefix.description: Literal string prepended to each formatted label value (e.g. "-" or "$").

suffix.description: Literal string appended to each formatted label value (e.g. "%" or "x").

color.description: Fixed CSS color for all labels. Overrides the default fill-derived color.

offsets.description: Per-series pixel offsets for fine-tuning label positions, keyed by series name.
offsets.deprecated:
Per-series pixel offsets are a workaround for collision bugs
now fixed by the layout engine. Will be removed in a future version.

fontSize.description: Font size in pixels for bar/column value labels.

LabelConfig.description: Label display configuration for chart data labels.

LabelDensity.description:
Label density mode controlling how many data labels are shown.
- 'all': show every label, skip collision detection
- 'auto': show labels with collision detection (default)
- 'endpoints': show only first and last per series (useful for line charts)
- 'none': hide all labels (rely on tooltips and legend)

show.description: Explicit on/off. When undefined, the chart auto-decides based on series count.

maxSeries.description: Maximum number of series before endpoint labels switch to a legend. Default 8.

ends.description:
Which ends of the chart get label columns.
- `'end'` (default): labels on the right (trailing) edge only.
- `'both'`: labels on both left (leading) and right (trailing) edges.

content.description:
What each entry renders.
- `'label'`: series name only.
- `'value'`: formatted value only.
- `'label value'`: series name and value joined on one line.

When omitted, entries render the series name with the formatted value on a second line (the classic endpoint column). Pass an object to set the leading and trailing columns independently, e.g. the classic slope-chart look is `{ leading: 'label value', trailing: 'value' }`.

valueField.description: Field to read the displayed value from. Defaults to `encoding.y.field`.

format.description: d3-format string for the value. Defaults to `encoding.y.axis.format`.

width.description: Max wrap width in pixels for long series names. Default 96.

showMarker.description: Render an open-circle marker on the line at the right edge. Default true.

showLeader.description: Render a thin leader line from the swatch row back to the line endpoint when collision-sweep displaces a label off its data point. Default false: the marker on the line plus the swatch in the column already pair label to data; the connector tends to add visual noise for small displacements. Opt in when labels collide hard and you need the explicit tie-back.

EndpointLabelsConfig.description:
Configuration for the endpoint labels column rendered at the chart's right edge for multi-series line/area charts. Each entry pairs the series name with its last formatted value, optionally anchored to the line by an open-circle marker.

The column is independent of the traditional `legend` and the legacy end-of-line labels. Together with `legend.show`, the three suppression toggles follow this truth table for ≥2-series line/area charts:

| `legend.show` | `endpointLabels` | Traditional legend | Endpoint column | End-of-line labels | |--|--|--|--|--| | unset | unset | hidden (auto-suppressed) | shown (default) | hidden | | true  | unset | shown                    | shown           | hidden | | unset | false | shown (auto-suppress revoked) | hidden     | hidden | | false | false | hidden                   | hidden          | shown (last-resort) | | true  | false | shown                    | hidden          | hidden | | false | true  | hidden                   | shown           | hidden | | true  | true  | shown                    | shown           | hidden |

Single-series charts: column is hidden by default (nothing to identify).

The implementation is in `packages/engine/src/legend/suppression.ts` — `resolveSuppression` is the single source of truth. The table above is a user-facing mirror; if the two ever diverge, the engine wins. Tests in `legend/__tests__/suppression.test.ts` enforce every cell.

EndpointLabelContent.description: Content composition for an endpoint-label entry: the series name, the formatted value, or both joined on one line. See  {@link  EndpointLabelsConfig.content } .

autoThin.description: Automatic annotation thinning at narrow widths. When true (default), annotations that can't be placed without overlap are demoted to numbered dot markers with footnote text below the chart. Set false to restore the pre-auto-thinning behavior (annotations hidden at compact breakpoints).

categorical.description: Categorical palette for nominal data (array of CSS color strings).

sequential.description: Sequential palettes keyed by name. Each is an array of color stops.

diverging.description: Diverging palettes keyed by name. Each is an array of color stops with a neutral midpoint.

background.description: Background color. Accepts a TokenValue for light/dark pairs.

text.description: Default text color. Accepts a TokenValue for light/dark pairs.

gridline.description: Gridline color. Accepts a TokenValue for light/dark pairs.

axis.description: Axis line and tick color. Accepts a TokenValue for light/dark pairs.

annotationFill.description: Annotation fill color. Accepts a TokenValue for light/dark pairs.

annotationText.description: Annotation text color. Accepts a TokenValue for light/dark pairs.

positive.description: Semantic color for positive/up-trend values. Accepts a TokenValue for light/dark pairs.

negative.description: Semantic color for negative/down-trend values. Accepts a TokenValue for light/dark pairs.

colors.description: Color palette overrides. Pass a flat string[] as shorthand for categorical colors, or an object for full control over categorical, sequential, diverging, etc.

title.description: Chart title. Default: 26.

subtitle.description: Subtitle below the title. Default: 14.

metricValue.description: KPI metric primary value. Default: 22. Delta/secondary derive from this.

sizes.description: Font size overrides in pixels. Partial — only specified keys are overridden.

weights.description: Font weight overrides. Partial — only specified keys are overridden.

chromeGap.description: Gap between chrome elements (title to subtitle, etc.).

chromeToChart.description: Gap between the last chrome element and the chart area.

chartToFooter.description: Gap between chart area and source/footer below.

axisMargin.description: Internal padding within the chart area (axes margins).

xAxisHeight.description: Height reserved below chart area for x-axis tick labels. Increase when large axisTick font sizes cause label clipping.

xAxisLabelPadding.description: Gap in pixels between the x-axis line and tick label text. Increase when larger axisTick fonts sit too close to the axis line.

borderRadius.description: Border radius for chart container and tooltips.

title.description: Title style override.

subtitle.description: Subtitle style override.

chrome.description: Per-element chrome style overrides. Pass a plain string for color-only (backward-compatible), or a ChromeThemeOverride object for full typography control (color, fontSize, fontWeight, lineHeight).

seriesStrategy.description: Series color assignment strategy. Default: 'palette' (full categorical palette always, zero visual drift).

ThemeConfig.description: User-facing theme configuration for overriding defaults. All fields are optional. The engine deep-merges these onto the default theme.

TokenValue.description: A color token value: either a plain CSS color string, or a light/dark pair. When a pair is given, the resolver picks the appropriate value based on dark mode state. When a plain string is given, dark-mode adaptation derives the dark value algorithmically (existing behavior).

color.description: Text color. Accepts a TokenValue for light/dark pairs.

fontSize.description: Font size in pixels.

ChromeThemeOverride.description: Per-element chrome theme override. Pass a plain string (color only, backward-compatible) or an object with full typography control.

SeriesStrategy.description:
Series color assignment strategy.

- `'palette'` — always assign from the full categorical palette (current   default, zero visual drift).
- `'accent-neutral'` — assign by series count: a single series gets the   accent (first categorical color) only; 2-4 series get accent for the   first and neutral grays for the rest; 5+ fall back to the full palette.

DarkMode.description:
Dark mode behavior.

- `"auto"` - Checks the `prefers-color-scheme` media query to detect the   user's system-level preference. This does NOT detect class-based dark mode   toggles (e.g. `document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark')`). If your   app uses class-based dark mode, use VizThemeProvider with `"force"` or   `"off"` instead of `"auto"` and toggle based on your app's state.
- `"force"` - Always render in dark mode regardless of system preference.
- `"off"` - Always render in light mode (default).

All components (Chart, Sankey, Graph) inherit darkMode from VizThemeProvider when no explicit prop is passed.

showPoints.description: Whether to show data point markers. Defaults to true.

SeriesStyle.description: Per-series visual style overrides for line/area charts.

chrome.description: Override editorial chrome at this breakpoint.

labels.description: Override label configuration at this breakpoint.

legend.description: Override legend configuration at this breakpoint.

annotations.description: Override annotations at this breakpoint.

animation.description: Override animation at this breakpoint.

display.description: Override display mode (`'full'` or `'sparkline'`) at this breakpoint.

watermark.description: Override watermark visibility at this breakpoint.

crosshair.description: Override crosshair behavior at this breakpoint.

ChartSpecOverride.description:
Breakpoint-conditional overrides for chart specs.

Allows specifying different chrome, labels, legend, or annotations per breakpoint. Merged shallowly into the base spec at compile time when the container matches the breakpoint.

AnimationSpec.description:
Animation spec property.
- true: enable entrance animation with sensible defaults
- false/omitted: no animation (current behavior)
- AnimationConfig: full control via enter/update/exit phases

enter.description: Entrance animation when chart first renders.

exit.description: Exit animation when marks are removed.

annotationDelay.description: Delay before annotations animate in (ms after marks). Default: 200.

AnimationConfig.description: Full animation config object. Structured as enter/update/exit phases following Vega's encoding set model.

duration.description: Duration in ms. Default: 500 for enter.

stagger.description: Stagger config. true = defaults, false = no stagger. Default: true for enter.

AnimationPhaseConfig.description: Animation phase config. Follows Vega's enter/update/exit model. Each phase can be true (use defaults) or a config object.

AnimationEase.description: Named easing presets for entrance animations. Uses CSS linear() curves. Named 'ease' (not 'easing') to match Vega convention.

delay.description: Delay between each element in ms. Default: 80

AnimationStagger.description: Stagger configuration for sequential element reveal.

Display.description:
Chart display mode.
- `'full'` (default): standard chart with chrome, axes, legend, padding.
- `'sparkline'`: minimal inline mini-chart. Strips chrome, axes, legend,   watermark, animation, and reduces margins to a tiny safety pad. The mark   fills the container edge-to-edge. Best with `mark: 'line' | 'area' | 'bar'`.   Explicit user fields (chrome, legend, encoding.x.axis, etc.) still render   when set, so users can opt in to specific elements.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text for the search input. Defaults to "Find a series".

SeriesSearchConfig.description: Configuration for the searchable series highlight input (`seriesSearch`). The boolean form (`seriesSearch: true`) uses the defaults.

from.description: The x value (matching `encoding.x`'s domain) where drawing starts. Data before this point renders normally; data at or after it is hidden behind a hatched "draw here" region until reveal.

prompt.description: Prompt text shown in the hatched drawing region. Defaults to "Draw your guess".

revealLabel.description: Label for the skip-to-reveal button. Defaults to "Show me".

comparisonLine.description: Optional extra comparison line (e.g. "what everyone else guessed"), supplied by the host app. Rendered in a third, visually distinct style alongside the reader's guess and the real line after reveal.

YouDrawItConfig.description: Configuration for the "you draw it" interactive engagement format (`youDrawIt`). The reader draws their guess of the trend from `from` to the right edge before the real line reveals. Line marks only, single-series only.

ResolveConfig.description: Per-channel resolution config. Controls whether scales, axes, and legends are shared or independent across layers.

ResolveMode.description: Resolution strategy for shared resources across layers. 'shared' (default): union domains, single axis/legend. 'independent': each layer gets its own scale/axis/legend.

x.description: Horizontal position channel. Required for: bar, line, area, point, tick, rect, lollipop. Maps a field to the x-axis. Use `type: 'temporal'` for dates, `'nominal'` for categories, `'quantitative'` for numbers.

y.description: Vertical position channel. Required for: bar, line, area, point, tick, rect, arc, lollipop. For arc marks, this is the value field (slice size). For all others it's the y-axis position.

color.description: Color channel. Required for arc marks (determines pie/donut slice coloring). Optional for all other marks -- used for series differentiation on multi-series charts, or heatmap intensity. Accepts a conditional definition to apply colors based on data predicates, or a bare `{ value }` constant (VL aligned; expanded to the mark-level fill/stroke).

size.description: Size channel. Used by point/bubble charts to scale dot area by a quantitative field. Accepts a conditional definition to vary size based on data predicates, or a bare `{ value }` constant (VL aligned; expanded to `mark.size`).

detail.description: Detail channel. Groups data into multiple series without mapping to a visual property. Useful when you want separate lines per category but don't need the color to differ.

key.description: Identity channel for data-update transitions. Maps a field whose value uniquely identifies each datum across updates. Mirrors Vega-Lite's key channel. Not visually encoded. Optional: charts derive sensible default keys.

x2.description: Secondary x position. Used with `x` to define a horizontal span (rect marks, error bars). Both `x` and `x2` must be quantitative.

y2.description: Secondary y position. Used with `y` to define a vertical span (rect marks, error bands). Both `y` and `y2` must be quantitative.

opacity.description: Data-driven opacity (0-1 range). Accepts a conditional definition to vary opacity based on data predicates (e.g., highlight selected points), or a bare `{ value }` constant (VL aligned; expanded to `mark.opacity`).

strokeDash.description: Stroke dash pattern encoding. Maps a nominal/ordinal field to different dash patterns on line and rule marks. Useful when color alone doesn't distinguish series well.

angle.description: Rotation angle encoding for point marks. Maps a quantitative field to 0-360 degrees.

text.description: Text content for `text` marks. Required when mark is `'text'`. Not meaningful for other mark types.

tooltip.description: Tooltip field(s). Shown on hover. Can be a single channel or an array for multi-field tooltips. Independent of the x/y/color encoding.

theta.description: Angular position (slice value) for arc marks (pie/donut), the canonical value channel in v8. Waffle and parliament marks accept it too (the same part-to-whole value channel). `y` is still accepted on these marks as a deprecated alias for backward compatibility (a compile warning is emitted and `y` is populated from `theta` internally). Not used by any other mark type.

facet.description: Facet channel: partitions data into a grid of small-multiple panels. Each unique value of the facet field produces one panel. Panels share scales by default; use `resolve: { scale: { y: 'independent' } }` for per-panel axes.

layer.description: Array of child layers (ChartSpec or nested LayerSpec).

data.description: Shared data inherited by children without their own data.

encoding.description: Shared encoding inherited by children (overridden per-channel by child).

transform.description: Shared transforms. Parent transforms run before child transforms.

title.description: Top-level title sugar (VL aligned). Expanded into `chrome.title`; `chrome.title` wins.

subtitle.description: Top-level subtitle sugar. Expanded into `chrome.subtitle`; `chrome.subtitle` wins.

width.description: Fixed render width in pixels (VL aligned). Overrides the container-derived width.

height.description: Fixed render height in pixels (VL aligned). Overrides the container-derived height.

$schema.description: Accepted for Vega-Lite compatibility and ignored (with a compile warning).

annotations.description: Annotations on the layered view.

labels.description: Label display configuration. `false` disables all labels, `true` uses defaults.

responsive.description: Whether the chart adapts to container width. Defaults to true.

watermark.description: Whether to show the tryOpenData.ai watermark. Defaults to true.

endpointLabels.description: Endpoint labels column, inherited by child layers that don't set their own.

animation.description: Animation configuration.

LayerSpec.description:
Layer specification: composites multiple chart layers into a single view.

Each element in `layer` is either a ChartSpec or another LayerSpec (nested). Shared data, encoding, and transforms at the LayerSpec level are inherited by children that don't define their own.

point.description:
Show point markers on line/area marks.
- true: filled circles at each data point
- 'transparent': invisible hover targets (legacy behavior)
- 'endpoints': show only first and last point per series (hollow dots)
- 'last' / 'first': show only the last (or first) point — filled dot,   no white halo. Useful for highlighting the latest reading on a line   chart and the default for sparkline mode.
- false: no point marks (default; uses voronoi overlay for tooltips)

interpolate.description: Curve interpolation for line/area marks. Maps to d3-shape curve factories.

orient.description: Explicit orientation override for bar marks.

innerRadius.description: Inner radius for arc marks. >0 produces a donut, 0 or omitted produces a pie.

startAngle.description: Start angle in radians for arc marks. Defaults to 0 (full pie/donut). Combined with `endAngle`, restricts the pie/donut to a partial sweep, e.g. `startAngle: -Math.PI / 2, endAngle: Math.PI / 2` for a half-donut (election-style results donut). Angles follow d3's convention: 0 is straight up, increasing clockwise. Only meaningful when `type` is `'arc'`.

endAngle.description: End angle in radians for arc marks. Defaults to 2*Math.PI (full pie/donut). See `startAngle`. Only meaningful when `type` is `'arc'`.

cornerRadius.description: Corner radius for rect/bar marks. 'pill' sets rx to half the bar thickness.

size.description: Fixed bar thickness in pixels for bar/column marks. When set, bars are this height (horizontal) or width (vertical), centered within the band.

filled.description: Whether the mark is filled (vs stroked only).

clip.description: Clip marks to the chart area.

trendline.description: Overlay a least-squares regression line on scatter (point) marks. Defaults to true. Set `mark: { type: 'point', trendline: false }` to suppress it when the chart already carries its own reference line (e.g. a manual x=y diagonal in a separate layer), which would otherwise produce two competing diagonals.

dx.description: Horizontal pixel offset from the data anchor. Only meaningful when `type` is `'text'`. Use it to lift a label clear of the mark it annotates instead of shifting the underlying data value.

dy.description: Vertical pixel offset from the data anchor (negative = up). Only meaningful when `type` is `'text'`. `{ type: 'text', dy: -10 }` floats each label ten pixels above its point.

align.description: Horizontal alignment of text marks relative to their anchor. Defaults to `'center'`.

baseline.description: Vertical alignment of text marks relative to their anchor. Defaults to `'middle'`.

fontSize.description: Font size in pixels for text marks. Ignored when the `size` encoding channel is present (which scales font size from a data field). `size` is already taken by bar thickness, hence the distinct name.

fillPattern.description:
Pattern-fill reinforcement for filled marks (bar, area, arc).

- `'auto'`: assign a per-series SVG pattern (diagonal hatch, dots,   crosshatch, vertical lines) layered over each series color so series   remain distinguishable without color vision. Marks too small to show   a legible pattern keep their solid fill.
- `'none'` (default): solid fills only.

style.description:
Visual style for range marks. Only meaningful when `type` is `'range'`.
- 'dumbbell' (default): a dot at each end joined by a connector line.   The start dot is muted, the end dot carries the accent color.
- 'arrow': a line with an arrowhead at the x2/y2 end, the strongest   "change between two points in time" form.
- 'bar': a plain floating range bar spanning start to end.

colorByDirection.description: Color range marks by direction of change. Only meaningful when `type` is `'range'`. When true, increases (x2 > x, or y2 > y) use the theme's `positive` semantic color and decreases use `negative`. A field-based `encoding.color` takes precedence over direction coloring.

units.description: Total number of cells in a waffle grid. Only meaningful when `type` is `'waffle'`. Category values normalize to this many cells via largest-remainder rounding so the grid always sums exactly. Default 100.

columns.description: Number of columns in a waffle grid. Only meaningful when `type` is `'waffle'`. Rows derive from `units / columns`. Default 10.

weekStart.description: First day of the week for calendar marks. Only meaningful when `type` is `'calendar'`. Controls which weekday occupies the top row of each band. Defaults to 'monday' (ISO week convention).

cellRadius.description: Corner radius in pixels for calendar day cells. Only meaningful when `type` is `'calendar'`. Defaults to 1.

fontSize.description: Font size in pixels for text marks. Ignored when the `size` encoding channel is present (which scales font size from a data field). `size` is already taken by bar thickness, hence the distinct name.

fillPattern.description:
Pattern-fill reinforcement for filled marks (bar, area, arc).

- `'auto'`: assign a per-series SVG pattern (diagonal hatch, dots,   crosshatch, vertical lines) layered over each series color so series   remain distinguishable without color vision. Marks too small to show   a legible pattern keep their solid fill.

style.description:
Visual style for range marks. Only meaningful when `type` is `'range'`.
- 'dumbbell' (default): a dot at each end joined by a connector line.   The start dot is muted, the end dot carries the accent color.
- 'arrow': a line with an arrowhead at the x2/y2 end, the strongest   "change between two points in time" form.
- 'bar': a plain floating range bar spanning start to end.

colorByDirection.description: Color range marks by direction of change. Only meaningful when `type` is `'range'`. When true, increases (x2 > x, or y2 > y) use the theme's `positive` semantic color and decreases use `negative`. A field-based `encoding.color` takes precedence over direction coloring.

units.description: Total number of cells in a waffle grid. Only meaningful when `type` is `'waffle'`. Category values normalize to this many cells via largest-remainder rounding so the grid always sums exactly. Default 100.

columns.description: Number of columns in a waffle grid. Only meaningful when `type` is `'waffle'`. Rows derive from `units / columns`. Default 10.

weekStart.description: First day of the week for calendar marks. Only meaningful when `type` is `'calendar'`. Controls which weekday occupies the top row of each band. Defaults to 'monday' (ISO week convention).

cellRadius.description: Corner radius in pixels for calendar day cells. Only meaningful when `type` is `'calendar'`. Defaults to 1.

shape.description: Seat layout shape for parliament marks. Only meaningful when `type` is `'parliament'`. `'hemicycle'` (default, and currently the only shape) packs seats into concentric semicircular arcs, party-grouped left to right.

seatRadius.description: Seat dot radius in pixels for parliament marks. `'auto'` (default) sizes dots to fill the available hemicycle rings for the given seat count. Only meaningful when `type` is `'parliament'`.

majorityLine.description: The majority-threshold line and "N to win" label on parliament marks. Only meaningful when `type` is `'parliament'`. `true` (default) draws the line at a simple majority (half the seats plus one); `false` hides it. transform.description: Data transforms applied in order before encoding (filter, bin, calculate, timeUnit).

title.description: Top-level title sugar (Vega-Lite aligned). Expanded into `chrome.title` (and `chrome.subtitle` for the object form). `chrome.title` wins when both are set.

subtitle.description: Top-level subtitle sugar. Expanded into `chrome.subtitle`; `chrome.subtitle` wins.

description.description: Alt text for the rendered chart (Vega-Lite aligned). Sugar for `a11y.description`; `a11y.description` wins when both are set. When absent, alt text is auto-generated from the spec and data.

width.description: Fixed render width in pixels (Vega-Lite aligned). Overrides the container-derived width. When both `width` and `height` are set, `responsive: false` is implied unless `responsive` is set explicitly. Omit for the default container-driven sizing.

height.description: Fixed render height in pixels (Vega-Lite aligned). See `width`.

labels.description: Label display configuration. `false` disables all labels, `true` uses defaults.

watermark.description: Whether to show the tryOpenData.ai watermark. Defaults to true.

seriesStyles.description: Per-series visual overrides, keyed by series name (the color field value).

animation.description:

resolve.description: Resolution strategy for shared/independent scales and axes across facet panels. Only meaningful when `encoding.facet` is present. Shared scales (the default) let readers compare across panels; independent scales give each panel its own domain.

zIndex.description: Render order within a LayerSpec. Higher values render on top. When omitted, layers render in array order (later layers paint on top). Axis assignment (left/right y) is always determined by array position, not zIndex.

point.description:

orient.description: Explicit orientation override for bar marks.

cornerRadius.description: Corner radius for rect/bar marks. 'pill' sets rx to half the bar thickness.

size.description: Fixed bar thickness in pixels for bar/column marks. When set, bars are this height (horizontal) or width (vertical), centered within the band.

filled.description: Whether the mark is filled (vs stroked only).

clip.description: Clip marks to the chart area.

align.description: Horizontal alignment of text marks relative to their anchor. Defaults to `'center'`.

baseline.description: Vertical alignment of text marks relative to their anchor. Defaults to `'middle'`.

columns.description: Number of columns in a waffle grid. Only meaningful when `type` is `'waffle'`. Rows derive from `units / columns`. Default 10.

cellRadius.description: Corner radius in pixels for calendar day cells. Only meaningful when `type` is `'calendar'`. Defaults to 1.

endAngle.description: End angle in radians for arc marks. Defaults to 2*Math.PI (full pie/donut). See `startAngle`. Only meaningful when `type` is `'arc'`.

cornerRadius.description: Corner radius for rect/bar marks. 'pill' sets rx to half the bar thickness.

size.description: Fixed bar thickness in pixels for bar/column marks. When set, bars are this height (horizontal) or width (vertical), centered within the band.

filled.description: Whether the mark is filled (vs stroked only).

clip.description: Clip marks to the chart area.

trendline.description: Overlay a least-squares regression line on scatter (point) marks. Defaults to true. Set `mark: { type: 'point', trendline: false }` to suppress it when the chart already carries its own reference line (e.g. a manual x=y diagonal in a separate layer), which would otherwise produce two competing diagonals.

dx.description: Horizontal pixel offset from the data anchor. Only meaningful when `type` is `'text'`. Use it to lift a label clear of the mark it annotates instead of shifting the underlying data value.

dy.description: Vertical pixel offset from the data anchor (negative = up). Only meaningful when `type` is `'text'`. `{ type: 'text', dy: -10 }` floats each label ten pixels above its point.

align.description: Horizontal alignment of text marks relative to their anchor. Defaults to `'center'`.

baseline.description: Vertical alignment of text marks relative to their anchor. Defaults to `'middle'`.

fontSize.description: Font size in pixels for text marks. Ignored when the `size` encoding channel is present (which scales font size from a data field). `size` is already taken by bar thickness, hence the distinct name.

fillPattern.description:
Pattern-fill reinforcement for filled marks (bar, area, arc).

- `'auto'`: assign a per-series SVG pattern (diagonal hatch, dots,   crosshatch, vertical lines) layered over each series color so series   remain distinguishable without color vision. Marks too small to show   a legible pattern keep their solid fill.
- `'none'` (default): solid fills only.

style.description:
Visual style for range marks. Only meaningful when `type` is `'range'`.
- 'dumbbell' (default): a dot at each end joined by a connector line.   The start dot is muted, the end dot carries the accent color.
- 'arrow': a line with an arrowhead at the x2/y2 end, the strongest   "change between two points in time" form.
- 'bar': a plain floating range bar spanning start to end.

colorByDirection.description: Color range marks by direction of change. Only meaningful when `type` is `'range'`. When true, increases (x2 > x, or y2 > y) use the theme's `positive` semantic color and decreases use `negative`. A field-based `encoding.color` takes precedence over direction coloring.

units.description: Total number of cells in a waffle grid. Only meaningful when `type` is `'waffle'`. Category values normalize to this many cells via largest-remainder rounding so the grid always sums exactly. Default 100.

columns.description: Number of columns in a waffle grid. Only meaningful when `type` is `'waffle'`. Rows derive from `units / columns`. Default 10.

weekStart.description: First day of the week for calendar marks. Only meaningful when `type` is `'calendar'`. Controls which weekday occupies the top row of each band. Defaults to 'monday' (ISO week convention).

cellRadius.description: Corner radius in pixels for calendar day cells. Only meaningful when `type` is `'calendar'`. Defaults to 1.

shape.description: Seat layout shape for parliament marks. Only meaningful when `type` is `'parliament'`. `'hemicycle'` (default, and currently the only shape) packs seats into concentric semicircular arcs, party-grouped left to right.

seatRadius.description: Seat dot radius in pixels for parliament marks. `'auto'` (default) sizes dots to fill the available hemicycle rings for the given seat count. Only meaningful when `type` is `'parliament'`.

majorityLine.description: The majority-threshold line and "N to win" label on parliament marks. Only meaningful when `type` is `'parliament'`. `true` (default) draws the line at a simple majority (half the seats plus one); `false` hides it. The object form overrides the threshold and label: `{ seats }` sets a custom seat count (e.g. a two-thirds supermajority) and `{ label }` overrides the default "N to win" text. A `seats` value outside `1..totalSeats` warns and falls back to the simple-majority default.

- `true` or `EndpointLabelsConfig`: render the column.
- `false`: hide the column.

type.description:
How to interpret the field values.
- quantitative: continuous numbers (scale: linear)
- temporal: dates/times (scale: time)
- nominal: unordered categories (scale: ordinal)
- ordinal: ordered categories (scale: ordinal)

aggregate.description: Optional aggregate to apply before encoding.

axis.description: Axis configuration. Set to `false` to suppress axis entirely (no space reserved). `null` is accepted as a VL-aligned alias for `false`.

stack.description:
Stacking behavior for quantitative channels (Vega-Lite aligned).

Vega-Lite accepts `'zero' | 'normalize' | 'center' | null`. OpenChart adds `true` (sugar for `'zero'`) and `false` (sugar for `null`) so callers can write `stack: true` / `stack: false` without learning the string forms. The string forms are still the canonical input — the boolean shorthand is normalized to the matching string before reaching layout.

- undefined: chart-type default (see below) -- stacked for bar/column/area
- true | 'zero': stack from zero baseline
- 'normalize': stack and normalize to fraction of total (0-1 per category)
- 'center': center stacks around zero (streamgraph style)
- null | false: no stacking -- renders grouped/dodged (bar) or overlap (area)

**Defaults differ by chart type:**
- **Bar/Column**: defaults to stacked (`'zero'`), Vega-Lite aligned. Use   `stack: null` (or `false`) for grouped/side-by-side bars.
- **Area**: defaults to stacked (`'zero'`), Vega-Lite aligned. Use   `stack: null` (or `false`) to opt into overlap rendering, where each   series renders as a translucent gradient band anchored at the   y-domain baseline.
- **Line**: stacking is not applied (lines always overlap).

- BinParams: bin with custom params (maxbins, step, etc.)

sort.description:
Sort order for categorical (nominal/ordinal) scale domains (Vega-Lite aligned).
- 'ascending': sort domain values ascending (default VL behavior)
- 'descending': sort domain values descending
- null: use data order (no sorting)
- undefined: ascending (VL default)
- 'x' | '-x' | 'y' | '-y': sort by another channel's values ('-' prefix   for descending). The VL ranked-bar idiom: `sort: '-y'` orders categories   by value, largest first. Resolved into an explicit domain during the   pre-validation sugar expansion.
- string[]: explicit value order. Listed values come first (in the given   order); unlisted data values follow in data order.
- SortByField: sort by the aggregated values of another field.

**Override precedence:** explicit user fields always win, even in sparkline mode. Setting `chrome.title` on a sparkline still renders the title. Setting `legend: { show: true }` still renders the legend. This applies at top-level and per-breakpoint overrides.

resolve.description: Resolution strategy for shared/independent scales and axes across facet panels. Only meaningful when `encoding.facet` is present. Shared scales (the default) let readers compare across panels; independent scales give each panel its own domain.

zIndex.description: Render order within a LayerSpec. Higher values render on top. When omitted, layers render in array order (later layers paint on top). Axis assignment (left/right y) is always determined by array position, not zIndex.
